preset.text:
4 players, 2 teams of 2. Partners sit across from each other.
N/S: players 1 & 3. E/W: players 2 & 4.
Use the 24-card deck (9 through Ace). First team to 10 points wins!

Each hand, players bid to name a trump suit.
Right Bower: Jack of trump — highest card!
Left Bower: Jack of same-color suit — second highest!
All trump cards beat non-trump cards.

Each player bids to accept or name trump. The team that bids (makers) must win 3+ tricks.
Win 3-4 tricks: 1 point. Win all 5 (march): 2 points.
Win fewer than 3 (euchred): opponents get 2 points!

You must follow the lead suit if able — Ludio will only let you play legal cards.
Remember: the Left Bower acts as trump, not its printed suit.
The dealer picks up the flipped card if someone orders up in Round 1 — then discards 1 card.
